name: Velinde's Effects
summary: In Darnassus, Velinde's Effects draw the Sentinels into an inquiry. The search concerns Sentinel Velinde Starsong, who vanished after years of service, and the journal Thyn'tel Bladeweaver asks you to retrieve from the Sentinels' quarters.

sections.title: A Trusted Sentinel
sections.body: Priestess Velinde Starsong served the night elves for many years and earned their deep trust. When she quietly vanished from her duties, the Sentinels believed she had left for personal reasons and expected her to return. Outsiders later found clues tied to the Tome of Mel'Thandris. Only then did Sentinel leaders allow an inquiry into Velinde's private belongings.

sections.title: The Chest in the Bunkhouse
sections.body: Thyn'tel Bladeweaver is stationed on Darnassus's Warrior's Terrace and gives you the key to Velinde's locked trunk. The trunk is kept in the Sentinels' bunkhouse on the Tradesmen's Terrace. Inside lies Velinde's personal journal, with accounts of her assignments and thoughts. Its pages trouble the Sentinels: they hint at secret affairs that drove Velinde to leave Teldrassil alone.

faq.answer: Velinde Starsong is a respected night elf priestess and Sentinel commander. Her devoted service earned deep respect from her peers before she vanished on an unexplained mission.
Velinde's chest is in the Sentinels' bunkhouse, on the upper floor of a building in Darnassus's Tradesmen's Terrace. Cross the elevated bridge from the neighboring mail armor shop to reach it.

faq.q: Why didn't the Sentinels search for her earlier?
faq.answer: The Sentinels trusted Velinde's spotless reputation. Her commanders believed she had sound private reasons to leave and expected her to return when her business was done.

faq.q: What is discovered inside the journal?
faq.answer: Velinde's journal shows her absence was more troubling than an ordinary leave. Thyn'tel Bladeweaver immediately seeks outside help to trace her route.

faq.q: How was Velinde connected to the Tome of Mel'Thandris?
faq.answer: The ancient elven text contained references to Velinde's past inquiries and activities. Those references first drew researchers and adventurers to investigate where she had gone.

faq.q: Where does the investigation lead after finding her effects?
aliases: where to go after velindes effects
faq.answer: The journal's clues lead toward the Barrens, following Velinde's steps south toward Kalimdor's transit hubs and ports.

angles.text: As a night elf, Velinde Starsong's story recalls the quiet sacrifices of the Sisterhood of Elune and the Sentinels. Her sudden disappearance unsettles her kin in Darnassus.
As an Alliance member, you can see how threats across Kalimdor challenge the fledgling Alliance leadership in Darnassus when high-ranking night elf officers need investigating.
As a priest, you can recognize Velinde as a revered priestess devoted to sacred duties. You have reason to trace what led her astray.
